instruction.vi: Chuẩn bị 1 phút rồi nói 1–2 phút; ghi âm và tự nghe lại.

questions.prompt_en: Describe a piece of news that interested you. You should say: what it was about; where you heard it; who it affected; why you remembered it.
questions.prompt_vi: Part 2: chuẩn bị 60 giây, nói tối đa 2 phút.

answer.model_en: I remember reading a news report about a city introducing more public buses on busy routes. I saw the story on a local news website while I was travelling home one evening. The report explained that the city wanted to reduce traffic and make journeys more convenient for people who did not own cars. It also included comments from passengers who hoped the service would become more reliable. I found the story interesting because transport affects so many aspects of everyday life. If a bus arrives late, students may miss classes and employees may be delayed on their way to work. I also liked the fact that the article included different opinions. Some residents were pleased about the plan, while others were concerned about the cost of maintaining additional services. After reading it, I discussed the issue with a friend who uses buses regularly. We agreed that adding routes could be helpful, but the timetable and ticket prices would matter just as much. I still remember the article because it was a practical local issue rather than a distant event. It made me pay more attention to how small decisions by local authorities can influence the routines of ordinary people.

questions.explanation_vi: Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc. Đối chiếu bốn tiêu chí nói.

phases.utterance_vi: Bạn sẽ có một phút chuẩn bị và tối đa hai phút nói. Hãy ghi từ khóa thay vì viết cả câu.
Ghi một ý cho từng gạch đầu dòng, sau đó nghĩ thêm một chi tiết hoặc ví dụ.
Nói tự nhiên; nếu bí ý, dùng một câu chuyển ý rồi nói tiếp.
Kiểm tra đã nói đủ ý, có ví dụ cụ thể và dùng thì phù hợp chưa. Mẫu chỉ để tham khảo, không bắt buộc học thuộc.
